name: Maeya Meiko
source:
A girl encountered on the way home.

She's shy, but when she gets accustomed to someone, she can be a bit selfish.

She is dressed in the uniform of a nearby wealthy girls' school, yet she claims to be a lost child...

[translated from [url=http://niji-kata.jpn.org/work/ameyono/ameyono.html]official website[/url]]
